_how: Messages the YRR app shows in the crawl during ad breaks, sweepers and promos. Rotates every 20 seconds. start/end are optional (Eastern time shown with -05:00). Expired lines are ignored, so old notices can stay until cleanup. Lines with "artist" also show in the crawl while that artist is playing that day. Birthdays come from the YRR Google Calendar (🎂 living, 🕯️ remembered).
